ruleDefinitions.name: Service Installation in Suspicious Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects service installation in suspicious folder appdata Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath, ServiceName

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\localhost.*"))) AND  NOT ((ServiceName = "Zoom\ Sharing\ Service" AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Zoom\\\\Support\\\\CptService\\\.exe.*")))
